description.zh: 实例id。>您可以调用[describedbinstances](~~196830~~)接口查看目标地域下所有实例的详情，包括实例id。
description.en: The instance ID. > You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~196830~~) operation to query the details of all instances in the target region, including instance IDs.

description.zh: 执行目标sql的实例id。>您可以调用[describedbinstances](~~196830~~)接口查看目标sql的详情，包括实例id。
description.en: The ID of the instance on which the target SQL statement is executed. > You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~196830~~) operation to query the details of the target SQL statement, including the instance ID.

description.zh: 目标sql的密码。>您可以调用[describedbinstances](~~196830~~)接口查看目标sql的详情，包括密码。
description.en: The password of the target SQL statement. > You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~196830~~) operation to query the details of the target SQL statement, including the password.

description.zh: 目标sql的id。>您可以调用[describedbinstances](~~196830~~)接口查看目标sql的详情，包括id。
description.en: The ID of the target SQL statement. > You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~196830~~) operation to query the details of the target SQL statement, including the ID.
The username of the destination instance.

description.zh: 实例所在地域id。>您可以调用[describeregions](~~196841~~)接口查看polardb-x支持的地域详情，包括地域id。
description.en: The region ID of the instance. > You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~196841~~) operation to query the regions supported by PolarDB-X, including region IDs.
The description of the target SQL statement.

description.zh: 执行目标sql的任务id。>您可以通过[describecloudcenterinstances](~~196830~~)接口查看polardb-x支持的目标sql的id。
description.en: The task ID for executing the target SQL statement. > You can call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~196830~~) operation to query the IDs of target SQL statements supported by PolarDB-X.

description.zh: 源rds实例是否开启源rds，取值范围如下：***enable**：开启源rds***disabled**：关闭源rds
description.en: Specifies whether to enable the source ApsaraDB RDS instance. Valid values: ***enable**: enabled. ***disabled**: disabled.

description.zh: 源端口号，取值范围为3200~3999。>当**dbendpointinstancetype**取值为**polardb-o**时，本参数才可用且必须传入。
description.en: The port number of the source instance. Valid values: 3200 to 3999. > This parameter is available and required only when **DBEndpointInstanceType** is set to **polardb-o**.

description.zh: 源rds实例id。>您可以调用[describedropsystemeventmetalist](~~196836~~)接口查看目标地域下所有的源rds实例详情，包括实例id。
description.en: The ID of the source ApsaraDB RDS instance. > You can call the [DescribeDropSystemEventMetaList](~~196836~~) operation to query the details of all source ApsaraDB RDS instances in the target region, including instance IDs.
The type of the source instance. Valid values: RDS_MYSQL, POLARX1, POLARX2_STANDARD, POLARX2_ENTERPRISE, and POLARDB_M.
The username of the source instance.
